tickerText: [TENNIS] Alexander Zverev beat Ben Shelton 6-3, 7-6(2), 5-7, 6-2 to win the US Open for his second major of 2026 after Elena Rybakina took the women's title and world No. 1 • [SQUASH] Sivasangari Subramaniam reached the Qatar Classic quarter-finals in 26 minutes as world No. 1 Mostafa Asal and top seeds advance in Doha • [BADMINTON] Malaysia's Aidil Sholeh upset Jason Teh to win the Vietnam Open men's singles; Tanvi Patri lifts the Asian U17 girls' crown in Chengdu • [PICKLEBALL] The Veolia Arizona Open opens Monday in Mesa with 1,000 ranking points and $1M+ in payouts as Anna Leigh Waters and Ben Johns lead the pro draws • [TABLE TENNIS] Truls Moregard and Miwa Harimoto crowned WTT Champions Macao singles winners — Moregard beat Calderano 4-1 and Harimoto edged Chen Yi 4-3 in seven games

newsItems.title: Zverev Claims US Open Crown
newsItems.excerpt: Top seed Alexander Zverev defeated Ben Shelton 6-3, 7-6(2), 5-7, 6-2 in New York to land his first US Open title and second Grand Slam of 2026, ending the American's bid to break a 23-year men's drought.

newsItems.title: Sivasangari Rolls in Doha
newsItems.excerpt: World No. 5 Sivasangari Subramaniam swept into the Qatar Classic quarter-finals with a 26-minute win over Salma Hany as PSA Platinum action continues at the Khalifa International Squash Complex.

newsItems.title: Aidil Ends Vietnam Open Wait
newsItems.excerpt: Malaysia's Aidil Sholeh Ali Sadikin beat top seed Jason Teh 21-16, 21-14 in Ho Chi Minh City to claim his first BWF World Tour men's singles title since 2024 and Malaysia's first in the discipline in over a year.

newsItems.title: Macao Champions Crowned
newsItems.excerpt: Sweden's Truls Moregard defeated Hugo Calderano 4-1 and Japan's Miwa Harimoto outlasted Chen Yi 4-3 to win the men's and women's singles titles at WTT Champions Macao on Sunday night.
